issue (medium): 🟡 **Dry-run workers cannot return a filled comment.md** **(non-blocking)**

A `--dry-run` worker stops before the upload (`outputs.md:61`), but `comment.md` is filled from the upload URLs at step 2. No step says how the posting session uses a worker's output.

Evidence: `skills/quality/impact-map/rules/outputs.md:61` (stops before the upload) · `skills/quality/impact-map/rules/outputs.md:68` (filled from upload URLs)

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `0760528`</sup>

<!-- fp:v2:intent:logic:-@skills/quality/impact-map/SKILL.md -->

suggestion (low): ⚪ **Page-only runs now need Chrome, with no fallback** **(non-blocking)**

Step 4 renders the PNGs on every run, but `render-png.mjs` exits 2 with no Chrome or Chromium. A page-only run on such a host now stops at Phase 5 instead of publishing.

Evidence: `skills/quality/impact-map/rules/outputs.md:56` (needs Chrome or Chromium)

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `0760528`</sup>

<!-- fp:v2:intent:edge-case:-@skills/quality/impact-map/rules/outputs.md -->
